name: VISGAB
description: A benchmarking suite for evaluating GAN-based virtual staining approaches on skin tissue histology images, including data and evaluation metrics.
evaluation_method: SSIM / FID / PSNR (image-similarity and realism metrics) and clinical/human evaluation
general_score_metric: SSIM (with FID and PSNR commonly reported)
reputation: Niche but recognized in computational pathology research for evaluating virtual staining methods; not broadly standardized in clinical practice.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; dataset sizes can be limited and stain-specific; image-similarity metrics may not correlate with clinical utility; requires clinical validation and is susceptible to domain shift.
